description: Files confirmed small-company accounts through the Companies House XML Gateway, over the deployed API, for companyNumber or, when clientId is given instead, for that practice client's own company number; returns the submission number. The company authentication code is not an argument: the user types it on the link request_companies_house_codes answers (kind accounts), and this call names that entry by codesEntryId. A single entry is used up by this call; a batch entry (clientIds) gives up only this clientId's codes, so run_for_clients can pass one codesEntryId for every client. poll_submission with kind accounts reaches the outcome. With revision, it files revised accounts that replace accounts already filed for the same period.

accountantsReport.description: Adds the accountants' report page and files the accounts as exempt from audit with an accountants' report

statement.description: The statement of the scope of the accountants' report

averageEmployees.description: The average number of employees in the period

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to resolve companyNumber from the client row instead

codesEntryId.description: The entryId request_companies_house_codes answered, once the user has typed the codes on its link

director.description: The signing director and the date the accounts were approved

documentLanguage.description: cy files the accounts in Welsh, which only a company registered in Wales may do: Companies House prints every statement, heading and label in Welsh. en, the default, files them in English

periodEnd.description: The accounting period's end date, YYYY-MM-DD

periodStart.description: The accounting period's start date, YYYY-MM-DD

registeredOffice.description: The registered office as address parts; taken from the company's Companies House record when left out

revision.description: Makes these revised accounts that replace the accounts already filed for the same period; director.dateApproved is then the date the directors approved the revision

amendments.description: The significant amendments the revised accounts make; Companies House prints it under "What the revised accounts change"

nonCompliance.description: How the accounts already filed did not comply with the Companies Act 2006; Companies House prints it under "What was wrong with the original accounts"

originalDateOfApproval.description: The date the directors approved the accounts already filed, YYYY-MM-DD; Companies House prints it in the statement that the revised accounts replace them

revisesReceipt.description: The name of the receipt of the accepted accounts these revise, ending .json, as list_accounts_receipts answers it; the filing route refuses one that is not found, not accounts, not accepted, part of a joint filing, already revised or for another company. Leave it out when the user does not have it

smallCompany.description: The figures and notes, as derive_small_company_accounts answers them plus principalActivity and accountingPolicies

accruals.description: Whole pounds of accruals and deferred income due within one year; 0 when left out

amountsOwedByDirectors.description: Part of debtors owed by directors; smallCompany.directorsAdvances then states each director's advance, closing at this total

amountsOwedToDirectors.description: The part of creditorsAfterOneYear owed to directors; 0 when left out

amountsOwedToGroupUndertakings.description: The part of creditorsAfterOneYear owed to group undertakings; 0 when left out

bankLoansAfterOneYear.description: The part of creditorsAfterOneYear owed to a bank; 0 when left out

bankLoansOverdrafts.description: Whole pounds owed to a bank within one year; 0 when left out

provisionsForLiabilities.description: Whole pounds of provisions; 0 when left out

taxationSocialSecurity.description: Whole pounds of PAYE, National Insurance and VAT owed within one year; 0 when left out

tradeDebtors.description: Part of debtors; with otherDebtors, amountsOwedByDirectors and prepayments it adds up to debtors

taxationSocialSecurity.description: Whole pounds of PAYE, National Insurance and VAT owed within one year; 0 when left out

controllingParty.description: Without a name, states that the company has no ultimate controlling party

name.description: Required when the party is ultimate

directors.description: Every director's name, at least one

directorsAdvances.description: Inside smallCompany: one row per director who owed the company money in the period, each named as in directors; Companies House prints them in the note on advances and credits to directors (section 413)

advanced.description: Whole pounds advanced to the director in the period

balanceAtEnd.description: Whole pounds owed at the end: balanceAtStart plus advanced less repaid

balanceAtStart.description: Whole pounds the director owed at the start of the period

name.description: The director, one of the directors the accounts name

repaid.description: Whole pounds the director repaid in the period

terms.description: The interest rate and the main conditions of the advance or credit

filleted.description: True to file the filleted copy, without the profit and loss account

fixedAssetNote.description: The classes the company holds, each by its name; a class it holds none of is left out

statementsAccepted.description: Every small-company statement, confirmed true by the user before filing
